heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋左圖右文直列（列間分隔線）
desc: 上方置中放標題，下方多個項目一列一筆直向排列：左側小圖、右側小標籤、標題與說明文字，列與列之間有分隔線，清單下方置中一顆按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上緣有一條橫跨畫面寬的分隔線。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目排成的直列，一列一筆，對齊頁面內容寬度；列與列之間有分隔線，分隔線與內容寬度同寬，最後一列下方沒有分隔線。每列左側放一張略為直式的圖片，約佔內容寬度的四分之一；右側文字欄佔其餘寬度，相對於圖片垂直置中，依序是小標籤、標題（可多行）與說明文字，小標籤與說明文字沒有時省略，說明文字過長時截斷並以省略號結尾。項目本身無外框，所有列的圖片同一比例、同一大小。清單下方置中可放一顆按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 標題組仍置中於上方。每列改為上下兩段：上段左側為圖片，約佔內容寬度的一半弱，右側放小標籤與標題，靠上對齊；下段是說明文字，橫跨整個內容寬度，位於圖片下方。列與列之間的分隔線與區塊上緣的分隔線保留，按鈕仍置中在清單下方。

en.name: Centered heading + image-left text-right list rows (dividers between rows)
en.desc: A centered heading sits at the top; below it, multiple items are stacked one per row: a small image on the left, with a label, title and description on the right, dividers between rows, and one button centered below the list.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. A divider spanning the full screen width runs along the top edge of the section. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group is a list of rows made of multiple items, one item per row, aligned to the page content width; there is a divider between rows, as wide as the content width, with no divider below the last row. Each row has a slightly portrait image on the left taking about a quarter of the content width; the text column on the right takes the remaining width and is vertically centered relative to the image, containing in order a label, a title (may wrap to multiple lines) and a description; omit the label and description when there is no content, and truncate an overly long description with an ellipsis. The items themselves have no border, and all row images share the same aspect ratio and size. Optionally place one button centered below the list; omit it when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The heading group stays centered at the top. Each row becomes two parts stacked vertically: in the upper part, the image is on the left, taking a little under half the content width, with the label and title on its right, aligned to the top; the lower part is the description, spanning the full content width below the image. The dividers between rows and the divider along the top edge of the section remain, and the button stays centered below the list.
